sample.evidence: Original inspected. Candidate tags: open_center; candidate describes scattered 'gold covered cells'. Eight purple-framed gold-faced objects occur in mirrored pairs along the sides and upper/lower rows. Difficulty and strategy hypotheses are both null; no unsupported hypothesis is present.

candidate_correction.observation: A contiguous rectangular tile field surrounds a rectangular central scenic hole. Eight purple-framed gold-faced objects occupy paired positions above, beside, and below the hole; their covered-cell state is unverified.

sample.evidence: Original inspected. Candidate tag: open_center; candidate describes raised purple corners, a wooden U, and lower legs around a central empty slit. The corner panels and wooden U are visible, but the lower-center gap is an externally open bottom notch, not an internal central hole: the board's actual middle contains colored tiles and the horizontal wooden bridge. The left lower wing has turquoise circular faces and the right lower wing has gold-faced objects, both occupied/blocked areas, not empty play gaps. Applying open_center without this distinction overstates the central emptiness. No split_regions is supported because the upper wooden/tile bridge joins the wings. Both hypotheses are null.

limitations: This is a bounded sampled quality review, not full independent validation of the 1,000-level batch. Twelve distinct originals were rendered and visually inspected at their native 405-by-720 resolution.

Selection uses the first, lower-middle and last available row in each of the four supplied shards: 1001/1126/1252, 1253/1378/1504, 1505/1630/1756 and 1757/1878/2000. All selected paths resolve to the exact original paths in sheets/index.json.
validation.json reports no repeated_observations; no additional repeated-description sample was indicated. Distinct wording and structural/hash validation were not treated as visual correctness.

The +10 animation/glow on level 1504 prevents full interpretation of the upper cream-column area even in the original. Object identities, covered-cell contents, hidden mechanics and future board changes are not established by screenshots.

All twelve sampled candidates have null difficulty_hypothesis and strategy_hypothesis, unknown verified difficulty/strategy and empty verified evidence. There were therefore no image-specific speculative hypotheses to substantiate, and none were invented.

Candidate corrections are explicit unaccepted proposals only. The original candidate claims are retained alongside observed evidence in this report; no shard, source image, taxonomy, tracker or app file was changed.

The conflict at 1252 includes incorrect panel-color wording and a proposed additional stair_step boundary tag. Nonexhaustive tags elsewhere were not automatically counted as conflicts. The open_center concern at 1126 requires review of whether the taxonomy is intended to include bottom-opening notches.
Sample outcomes: 8 supported, 2 conflict and 2 uncertain. Supported means the sampled visible claims are supported, not that the entire record or batch is accepted.
